_comment: Interior wall end pieces for gTileset_OrleansConservatory (own art, make_caps.py). Each piece is a plain bottom-layer cell (layer type normal, behaviour normal, blocks like the cell it replaces). 'palettes' = the existing palette slot each 8x8 tile fits (no new colours).

cv_top0_L.where: glass roof row 0, left end (x=0, y=0)

cv_top0_R.where: glass roof row 0, right end (x=W-1, y=0)

cv_top1_L.where: glass roof row 1, left end (x=0, y=1)

cv_top1_R.where: glass roof row 1, right end (x=W-1, y=1)

cv_foot.where: both bottom corners (x=0 and x=W-1, y=H-1)
